title: Give every concrete telemetry item exactly one owning wagon

facts.note: Wagon plan files carrying produce[] entries; the source's fix hint locates a wagon plan at plan/commons/_commons.yaml. This identifies wagon plans only, not tracking-plan items.

The source does not establish a path pattern for tracking-plan items; an observer that recognises concrete tracking-plan items (and resolves each to its logical artifact URN) is needed. Path alone is not claimed to identify them.
The rule is a state invariant over all concrete items: it applies whenever the plan is validated or authored, including full-plan checks where the defective item itself was not edited.
Optional activation signal only (makes it likely a defect was introduced); NOT a prerequisite. Unchanged defective items still violate the rule.
Validator planner_telemetry_plan reports zero/multiple producers or owner mismatch per item under the telemetry profile.

fires: A planner adds a concrete tracking-plan item whose logical artifact no wagon's produce[] telemetry declares.
Two wagons' produce[] telemetry both name the same logical artifact URN that a tracking-plan item resolves to.
A tracking-plan item's owner names a wagon other than the one whose produce[] declares its logical artifact.
A wagon's produce[] telemetry entry is removed or renamed while concrete items still resolve to that artifact.
A full-plan validation (or an unrelated plan edit) evaluates an existing, unchanged tracking-plan item that has zero producers, multiple producers, or a mismatched owner.
planner.wagon.telemetry-filesystem already reports a wagon-level duplicate producer under the planner profile; this rule still reports the affected item under the telemetry profile.
doesNotFire: A concrete item whose logical artifact is declared by exactly one wagon's produce[] telemetry and whose owner equals that wagon's slug.
A wagon produce[] entry with no telemetry field and no concrete tracking-plan item resolving to it.

given: A plan contains concrete tracking-plan items, each resolving to a logical telemetry artifact URN telemetry:{theme}:{artifact}.
when: Any concrete tracking-plan item is authored, changed, or evaluated (including full-plan validation of unchanged items).
then: Ensure each item's logical artifact is declared in exactly one wagon's produce[] telemetry (string or list), and the item's owner equals that wagon's slug.
prefer: Declare the logical artifact on the producing wagon's produce[] entry (telemetry: telemetry:{theme}:{artifact}, contract may be null), then set the item's owner to that wagon's slug.
Decide ownership in the plan first; treat the registry only as something that resolves against plan-declared ownership.
avoid: Concrete items whose artifact no wagon's produce[] declares (emitted by code no plan stands behind).
Declaring the same logical artifact in two wagons' produce[] (two authors, no arbiter).
An owner field that names a wagon other than the declaring one, or relying on the registry to grant ownership.
Treating a wagon-level duplicate-producer finding (planner profile) as covering or exempting the item-level check; both apply.
why: Two producers make an emission contract a coincidence waiting to diverge; zero means no wagon stands behind the observable outcome. Both are plan defects, caught at the item.
evidence: Validator planner_telemetry_plan reports no planner.telemetry.logical-ownership finding over the whole plan.
For each concrete item, exactly one wagon has a produce[] telemetry declaration naming the logical artifact URN, and item.owner equals that wagon's slug.
verifier_detail: ownership_declaration: a wagon produce[] entry whose telemetry field (string or list) names the logical artifact URN telemetry:{theme}:{artifact}; ownership lives in the plan, not in the registry.
owner: the tracking-plan item field naming the wagon slug accountable for the artifact; must equal the wagon whose produce[] declares the logical artifact.

Per item (all concrete items, not only changed ones): count distinct wagons whose produce[].telemetry names the artifact; 0 => finding (no owner), >1 => finding (ambiguous producers), 1 but owner != that slug => finding.

Overlap: duplicate producers at the wagon level are also reported by planner.wagon.telemetry-filesystem under the planner profile; this rule reports the same ambiguity at the item level under the telemetry profile, so an adopting repository sees it whichever profile it runs. This is a separate check, not an exemption or waiver: the item-level invariant applies regardless of whether the wagon-level finding exists.

Fix-hint example from source:
  # plan/commons/_commons.yaml
  produce:
    - name: commons:response-invocation
      contract: null
      telemetry: telemetry:commons:response-invocation-accepted
audit: Source name: Concrete telemetry resolves to exactly one wagon-owned logical artifact.
Source comment: strict: atdd-bun fails on every finding; it has no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.
